jobs.description:
Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Job description 

Your job in a nutshell In the evening, when others go to sleep, your workday begins. Between 22h and 00h, you depart with a refrigerated truck towards your first delivery. You drive throughout Belgium and deliver to various supermarkets. No stressful city driving, but clear routes and a well-organised schedule.

What will you do? • You load and unload using an electric or manual pallet jack • You deliver fruits and vegetables to supermarkets across Belgium • You check deliveries and documents • You drive independently and take responsibility for your own route • You ensure correct and safe deliveries

What does your day look like? • You start at night at the depot, pick up your truck and depart on your route • During your shift you typically make 2 to 6 stops per night and complete your deliveries efficiently. Your workday lasts on average 12 to 15 hours, but you work within a clear and structured system without chaos or unnecessary stress • After your round, you return to the depot (Geel) and your workday is finished—and the best part? You simply sleep at home in your own bed

What do we expect from you? • CE driving licence with certificates (Code 95 – medical fitness certificate) • Good knowledge of English is a must, Lithuanian is a plus • You are flexible and customer-oriented • You live in the Geel region • You perform physical work with a smile • Willingness to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays)

What do you get in return? • A very good salary in relation to your effort and hours • Many working hours, no hotel nights—always sleeping at home • Working with clear structure and fixed routes • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

Interested? Apply today and jump on board!

 Requirements 

• CE driving licence with certificates • Flexible mindset • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian • Living in the Geel region

Take the next step in your accounting career within an international real estate environment. An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Senior Accountant with a background in Property Management or Real Estate, looking to take on a hands-on and autonomous role within an international property group.

This position goes beyond traditional accounting responsibilities. You will play an important role in ensuring the continuity of daily accounting operations while bringing your expertise to the optimisation of existing processes and financial systems. Working directly with the Finance Manager and senior management, you will have the opportunity to challenge current practices, make recommendations and contribute to the development of a more efficient accounting environment.

This opportunity is particularly suited to an experienced accounting professional who combines strong technical knowledge with professional maturity, initiative and the ability to adapt to an evolving organisation.

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

• Take ownership of day-to-day accounting operations, ensuring accuracy, efficiency and compliance with internal procedures.
• Handle supplier invoices, customer billing, payment processing and general ledger entries.
• Monitor accounting transactions and ensure the accuracy and consistency of financial records.
• Manage accounting activities related to property operations, ensuring reliable financial information and appropriate follow-up.
• Work with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and its associated accounting functionalities and systems.
• Review existing accounting processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reliability and reporting quality.
• Challenge established practices and make constructive recommendations to optimise accounting workflows.
• Work closely with the Finance Manager to ensure continuity across accounting activities and support the smooth running of the finance function.
• Contribute to process optimisation, system improvements and ongoing transformation initiatives.
• Support the development and implementation of improved accounting procedures and working methods.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient financial operations and effective communication.

About You : 

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• You have approximately 5 to 10 years of relevant professional experience in accounting. More experienced candidates are also welcome.
• You have previous experience in Property Management, Real Estate, property development or a related environment. This is considered a strong advantage.
• You possess solid knowledge of general accounting operations, including supplier accounting, customer invoicing, payment processing and general ledger activities.
• You have experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365. Knowledge of similar ERP systems is also valuable.
• You communicate fluently in both French and English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus.
• You are highly autonomous and comfortable taking ownership of accounting responsibilities from day one.
• You demonstrate professional maturity and have the confidence to challenge existing processes, identify inefficiencies and make constructive recommendations.
• You are comfortable combining hands-on accounting responsibilities with process optimisation and change management initiatives.
• You are a quick learner who can adapt easily to new systems, procedures and organisational requirements.
• You demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to maintain high standards of accuracy and quality.
• You are proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented, with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different stakeholders.

Bij Kurkumama koken we Perzisch eten zoals we het zelf graag eten. Onze khoresh heeft tijd nodig, dus je begint eraan lang voor de eerste bestelling. En als iemand het voor het eerst proeft, nemen we even de tijd om uit te leggen wat er in de pot zit.
 

We zoeken een kok die graag zelf aan het fornuis staat. Je zet de mise-en-place klaar, kookt en werkt de gerechten af. Als het druk wordt, hou je samen met de collega’s aan de counter het overzicht. Je proeft, stuurt bij waar nodig en laat je werkplek klaar achter voor de volgende shift.
 

Heb je nog nooit Perzisch gekookt? Dan leren we je graag onze gerechten kennen. Je kan voltijds of deeltijds aan de slag bij Kurkumama, Waterpoort 2 in Kortrijk, met een contract van bepaalde of onbepaalde duur. Vertel ons gerust wat jij graag kookt: https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs of jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.
 

ENGLISH 
At Kurkumama, we cook Persian food the way we like to eat it. Our khoresh takes time, so you start it well before the first order comes in. And when someone tries it for the first time, we take a moment to tell them what’s in the pot.
 

We’re looking for a cook who likes being at the stove. You’ll prep, cook and finish dishes. When it gets busy, you’ll work with the team at the counter to keep service moving. You’ll taste as you go, adjust when something needs it and leave the station ready for the next shift.
 

If you haven’t cooked Persian food before, we’ll teach you our dishes. Full-time or part-time at Kurkumama, Waterpoort 2, Kortrijk. A fixed-term or open-ended contract is possible. Tell us what you love to cook: https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs or jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.

Je ontwikkelt en test recepten, begeleidt onze keukenleads en helpt de centrale productie slimmer organiseren. Je kijkt naar smaak, porties, kostprijs en verspilling. Als een recept op papier klopt maar tijdens de service niet werkt, ga je met het team aan de slag tot het wel werkt. Je werkt vanuit Kortrijk met de keukenteams van Kurkumama Group. Vertel ons over een gerecht of een keuken die jij beter hebt gemaakt. Solliciteer via https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs of jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.
 

ENGLISH 
Coming up with a new dish is one thing. Making sure it tastes just as good in the middle of a busy service takes someone who’ll get in the kitchen with the team. That’s the Executive Chef we’re looking for.
 

You’ll develop and test recipes, coach our kitchen leads and improve how we work in the central kitchen. You’ll pay attention to flavour, portions, cost and waste. When a recipe works on paper but falls apart in service, you’ll work through it with the team. You’ll be based in Kortrijk and work with kitchen teams across Kurkumama Group. Full-time or part-time. Tell us about a dish or a kitchen you’ve helped make better. Apply at https://kurkumama.fillout.com/jobs or jobs@kurkumamagroup.com.

What if you could build the systems that allow industrial machines to understand where they are, decide where to go, and navigate safely through the real world?At M-ECS, you’ll help shape the next generation of autonomous off-highway vehicles and mobile robotic platforms. You'll work at the intersection of robotics, navigation and intelligent vehicle systems, developing the technology that enables machines to understand their position, plan their movements and navigate safely through complex environments. You’ll have the opportunity to help shape the autonomy stack from the ground up, from SLAM and localization to planning, decision-making and real-world deployment.You’ll see your work move from 
algorithm → machine → real-world impact.
 

 
 

YOUR ROLE, YOUR IMPACT. As a Autonomous Navigation & SLAM Engineer, you’ll take ownership of the navigation and autonomy capabilities that enable mobile machines to operate safely and intelligently in complex, dynamic environments.
 

Key responsibilities: 
 
 

• Autonomy & Navigation: Developing navigation capabilities, including SLAM, localization, pose estimation and 2D/3D mapping. 

• Path Planning: Implementing global and local path planning, cost maps and collision-free trajectory generation for safe and efficient autonomous operation. 

• Behavioral Planning & Decision-Making: Developing intelligent real-time behaviors, including obstacle detection, prediction and avoidance, for actions such as driving, stopping, following and overtaking. 

• Sensor Fusion: Integrating data from cameras, LiDAR, radar, IMU and GNSS to improve localization, environmental awareness, and navigation. 

• Obstacle Detection & Avoidance: Developing capabilities to detect, predict and avoid obstacles in dynamic environments. 

• Real-Time Optimization: Improving navigation and planning algorithms for efficient real-time execution on embedded and GPU-based platforms. 

• System Integration & Validation: Integrating, testing, debugging and validating autonomous navigation systems together with other engineers, both in simulation and on real machines in the field. 

ARE YOU THE ONE?You're a 
hands-on engineer with a genuine 
passion for 
robotics, autonomous navigation and SLAM. You're fascinated by how machines understand their position, map their surroundings and navigate complex environments. You enjoy 
tackling technical challenges, developing algorithms and 
turning ideas into working solutions. You don't stop at simulation or the drawing board. You love programming, testing, debugging and seeing your work come to life on real machines. You're 
curious, 
analytical and 
eager to explore new technologies. You take 
initiative, think beyond the obvious and enjoy experimenting, solving problems and building intelligent systems alongside your team.
 
 

• A 
Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Automation, AI, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

• A background/experience in (mobile) robotics, autonomous vehicles or industrial automation. 

• Experience with or 
technical knowledge of: 
 

• Autonomous navigation, 
SLAM, localization and state estimation, mapping, including LiDAR/visual SLAM, EKF or factor-graph approaches. 

• Path planning and trajectory optimization, e.g. A*, D* or RRT/RRT* 

• Programming in C++ and Python 

• Robotics frameworks such as ROS/ROS2 

• 3D Geometry, coordinate transformations, kinematics, sensor fusion, and real-time system constraints.   

• Experience with off-highway machinery, autonomous vehicles or AGVs, behavior trees, OMPL/MPC, GPU acceleration, simulation tools such as Gazebo, CARLA or Isaac Sim, NVIDIA Jetson or safety-critical systems is a plus. Experience testing or deploying robotic systems on real machines in the field is also a plus! 

• Strong communication skills in 
English and 
Dutch.
